&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHello customers!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI am so glad you could make it to my keynote!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eFirst, I would like to apologize for this one being a &e&olittle later &ethan usual.
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThere is an ongoing lawsuit between myself and a [[Abiphones & Co.|counterfeit Abiphone]], which has been taking up most of my time.
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHowever, I am here, and so are you, so let's begin!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &e...
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAhem.
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSince my previous keynote, my minions and I have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the &6Abiphone Flip&e.
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWe thought and thought and then thought some more before I, and only I, had an &oincredible breakthrough&e.
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWhat if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone?
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAfter all, less downtime for my clientele means I get more uptime on my all-inclusive holidays!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo, without further ado, I am proud to present:
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lABIPHONE FLIP
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lPLUS!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the &bSpeed Dial &efeature!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAlso, in my infinite generosity, I have given this model an &aadditional contact slot&e!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThat's all for this year. &bUdel's Abiphone Services &eappreciate your continued support during the ongoing lawsuit!
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo, without further ado...
&e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe &6Abiphone Flip+ &eis now for sale!
